Devon: I'll drop the FAQ in GDrive. Also who manages invoice for voucher reimbursements? Finance or partnerships?

OpsBot: calendar-bot: Event created: 'SI Starter Ops Sprint — Kickoff' 2024-06-15 10:00-11:00 PT. invite: #partners + eng leads.

Priya: Marketplace checklist snippet:
```
- logo (SVG + PNG)
- 1-pager PDF
- pricing matrix
- support SLAs
```
Anika: Added. Also decision: co-announcement date target is two weeks post-launch unless security review bumps it. @Marco ok?
Marco: :thumbsup: works for us. One more — hardware vouchers: who will be oncall for pickup logistics day-of?
Devon: I can coordinate logistics. I'll create a quick 'day-of runbook' and drop link here.
Priya: Perfect. For the listing, need to confirm compatible instance types and supported quantization. @Jon can you state recommended GPU SKUs in the FAQ?
Jon: I'll add a short table, e.g., A100-40GB baseline, H100 for high throughput. Also note quantized 4-bit tested on our runtime.
Marco: Cool. Anything else?
